blocks.text: Tree data structure maloomat ko ek markazi nuqte se phailte hue tarteeb deta hai; is nuqte ko root node (jarr) kehte hain. Tree mein maloomat ke har tukre ko node kehte hain, aur ek node doosre nodes se jur sakta hai. Is tarah shaakhon (branches) wali banawat banti hai. Yeh list se mukhtalif hai, jis mein items ek seedhi line mein ek ke baad ek hote hain.

Misal: family tree (khandani shajra) mein sab se purane buzurg root node hote hain, yahin se darja-bandi (hierarchy, oopar se neeche tarteeb) shuru hoti hai. Har shakhs ki aulad agle level banati hai. Kitab ki Figure 4.5 mein oopar dada-dadi, un ke neeche walid-walida aur chacha-chachi, aur sab se neeche bachche aur cousins dikhaye gaye hain. Walidain aur aulad ke aise rishte seedhi list mein achhi tarah nahi rakhe ja sakte, is liye tree istemal hota hai, jis se maloomat saaf dikhti aur aasani se milti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein Figure 4.5 ke baad yeh jumla chhapa hai: “Certainly! Here's a simplified version ...”. Yeh editing mein reh jane wala faltu jumla hai (kisi writing assistant ka jawab); sabaq ka hissa nahi.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq tree data structure ka tasawwur sab se pehle computer scientist John McCarthy ne 1960 mein pesh kiya.

blocks.prompt: Family tree ko list ki bajaye tree mein rakhna kyun behtar hai?
blocks.explanation: List sirf ek seedhi tarteeb rakhti hai, jabke tree yeh bhi rakhta hai ke kaun kis ka walid hai, yaani shaakhon wali darja-bandi.

items: Tree: root se phailte nodes; family tree jaisi darja-bandi ke liye munasib.
